title: Less but Sufficient: Relation Knowledge Selects Compact Knowledge-Graph Contexts, and What External Checks Can and Cannot Catch
abstract: arXiv:2611.01733v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) read knowledge-graph facts ranked by relevance, leaving open whether they suffice or conflict. Our checks use relation knowledge, written by hand or learned from training questions labelled with their relation paths. It selects a compact context of facts yielding an answer, and derives it; a derivability check tests whether an answer follows, a consistency check whether facts conflict, and a validation-chosen routing gate decides where the derived answer replaces the LLM's. Seven open LLMs read the compact context better in exact match than relevance-ranked facts; on ComplexWebQuestions (CWQ) they match SubgraphRAG's facts at a quarter of the prompt tokens, and stronger LLMs read SubgraphRAG's better. Where the routing gate passes, ours leads SubgraphRAG's in exact match in all 53 LLM, benchmark and prompt settings. A precision gate, returning the derived answer only when the check passes with exactly one der

translated_title: 少而足矣：用关系知识选择紧凑的知识图谱上下文，以及外部检查能捕捉与不能捕捉什么
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通常读取按相关性排序的知识图谱事实，但这些事实是否足以推出答案或是否存在冲突仍悬而未决。我们的检查方法使用关系知识，这些知识既可以手工编写，也可以从标注了关系路径的训练问题中学习得到。该方法选择出一个能够得出答案的紧凑事实上下文，并从中推导答案；可推导性检查测试答案是否能从上下文推出，一致性检查测试事实之间是否冲突，而由验证集选择的路由门控则决定在何处用推导出的答案替换LLM给出的答案。七个开源LLM在精确匹配指标上阅读紧凑上下文的效果优于阅读按相关性排序的事实；在ComplexWebQuestions（CWQ）上，它们仅使用四分之一的提示词token就达到了与SubgraphRAG事实相当的效果，而更强的LLM则能更好地阅读SubgraphRAG的事实。在路由门控通过的情况下，我们的方法在全部53个LLM、基准和提示词设置组合中的精确匹配上都领先于SubgraphRAG。精度门控仅在检查恰好得出一个可推导答案时才返回该推导答案……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出基于关系知识从知识图谱中筛选出足以推导答案的紧凑事实上下文，并辅以可推导性检查、一致性检查和路由门控等外部检查机制，使开源LLM在CWQ上仅用四分之一提示token即可达到与SubgraphRAG相当甚至更优的精确匹配性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes selecting compact, answer-sufficient fact contexts from knowledge graphs using relation knowledge, combined with derivability, consistency, and routing-gate checks, enabling open LLMs to match or outperform SubgraphRAG in exact match on CWQ with only a quarter of the prompt tokens.
